name: Credit spreads
summary: US high-yield spreads 3.34% on 16 Nov, below the 3.48% one-year high and inside the 4% Watch line
state: The US high-yield option-adjusted spread was 3.34% on 16 Nov, the latest reading, about 3bp wider on the month and below its one-year high of 3.48% (FRED). Both the level and the monthly change are well inside the 4% and 100bp Watch lines.
for_you: Wider spreads would mean higher borrowing costs for riskier companies; current levels show no sign of credit strain. This describes conditions only.
rubric_hit: HY OAS 3.43% below the 4% Watch line

sources.title: FRED — ICE BofA US High Yield OAS (BAMLH0A0HYM2)

why: High-yield spreads show how much lenders demand to fund weaker companies — an early warning of defaults and credit crunches.
drivers: Default expectations, risk appetite, rates, private-credit stress, fund outflows.

rubric.alert: HY OAS > 6.0%, or widened > 200bp in a month.
